I replied to Marcus in the #north-team thread to confirm I've noted that the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 21 December. He said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.

The brain saves channel messages automatically, so his note is on record. I searched the brain and found nothing that contradicts the date. That search was keyword-only, though, so a record that words the deadline differently could still have been missed.
